findings.fact: Model.Ref has optional variant. Info.variants lists IDs plus arbitrary settings/headers/body overlays. Only IDs and bounded display capability strings are candidates for public projection; never export overlay objects.

Session.Info has optional agent/model; Assistant has required agent/model. Distinguish session setting observation from per-assistant-message runtime report. Neither a successful switch ACK nor an absent model field proves a provider used the requested model.
model.default returns Model.Info|undefined, not a Model.Ref or resolved session variant. Do not infer a default variant from catalog ordering or model.default.

Current catalog returns name/status and opaque provider-model hash only. send switches explicit id/providerID, keeps both baseline policy calls, then text-only prompt. refresh validates session ID/location and generation, but public projection omits session agent/model and assistant model. No provider call executed during inspection.

FileAttachment URI is a generic string, with optional name/description/mention. This type establishes neither safe URI schemes nor supported bytes, size, source access, protected paths or provider compatibility. Do not pass arbitrary renderer URI to Native.

Existing line feedback produces version-bound, bounded selected text plus reference metadata and appends it atomically to the composer. It performs no IO/hash/automatic send. Reuse its observation authority rather than introduce competing selection versions.
